claim_summary: The optimal cardinalities of binary non-overlapping codes invariant under word reverse complement at lengths 2 through 16 are 1,0,1,0,2,0,5,2,14,10,42,44,132,170,430 respectively, with integral clique-multicover optimality certificates; such codes exist for all even lengths and all odd lengths at least 9, but not odd lengths 3,5,7.
integrity: Every finite maximum has a feasible code and a checkable integer clique multicover with equal weight; the general threshold has an explicit constructive proof. No independent external scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The full capacity sequence is determined only through length 16; the all-length result is a positivity criterion, not a general optimum formula. The binary involution does not model quaternary DNA without modification. Historical priority has residual risk from unindexed strand-invariant synchronization-code literature.
title: Reverse-complement-closed non-overlapping binary codes: an exact initial spectrum and an odd-length threshold
